legacy_migration.trigger: A locked script establishes a moving multi-vehicle group entering an unfamiliar bottleneck whose danger depends on adjacent lanes and forward access
legacy_migration.directing_decision: Show macro entry/formation, then prove loss of mobility with a forward vehicle anchor plus a dense-route total before beginning local target search
legacy_migration.coverage: City/route total → grouped-vehicle exterior → principal forward interior → queue total → restricted side-window anchor
legacy_migration.blocking: Lock `vehicle_id`, `lane_id`, and forward-exit direction; keep principal occupants in their established seats until a later state change
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Hold route views only long enough to register topology; reset at route-state changes rather than using a fixed duration
legacy_migration.sound: `UNKNOWN`; no engine, radio, score, or warning cue is prescribed
legacy_migration.applicability: Convoy, escort, evacuation, toll, parking, or traffic scenes where access topology drives danger
legacy_migration.non_applicability: Single room/vehicle with an already-known axis; one continuously visible attacker; or deliberate total geographic denial is the intended experience
legacy_migration.failure_mode: High views become scale decoration; principal vehicle cannot be located in the lane field; road/vehicle direction or color drifts
legacy_migration.counterexample: `NOBODY-2021-BUS-001` is a different-trigger boundary: its known single-vehicle longitudinal axis does not need repeated macro-road mapping. Same-trigger contrary evidence remains `UNKNOWN/pending`.
legacy_migration.unknown: Exact route, mission, escape options, grouped-vehicle membership, sound, and causal interpretation
legacy_migration.ai_risk: `VERY HIGH`: dense vehicles, road topology, reflections, scale changes, and background identity drift
legacy_migration.fallback: Use a project-original three-vehicle maximum and four pictures: route total → principal forward → queue total → side-window anchor; optionally use a non-photoreal internal lane map, never an on-screen branded graphic
